note: C++ type/member FQNs use the :: namespace separator and full parameter types in parens (ns::Class::method(type1, type2)), never a C#-style /arity suffix. Symbol model = types + constructors + methods; the data member id_ is NOT a symbol (consistent with the Python/TS/C# batches). Trailing cv-qualifiers (Id() const) are not part of the FQN, per the adapter's pinned normalization rules.
